name: Bisate Lodge
niche_feature: Lodge of six forest villas (shaped like giant birds' nests) on the edge of Volcanoes National Park, run by Wilderness; base for mountain gorilla and golden monkey trekking.
evidence_quote: Six architecturally striking forest villas, each designed as an homage to Rwandan royal heritage, overlooking Mount Bisoke, Karisimbi and Mikeno.
reason: Lodge on the edge of Volcanoes National Park; wildlife (gorilla) viewing is the core activity; all six villas are the same type.
page_issues: Operator is Wilderness per official site, not andBeyond (page and meta description say andBeyond)
Official site says the lodge is on the edge of / walking distance from Volcanoes National Park, not inside it
Gorilla permit price and travel-time figures not checked against the source

name: Campi ya Kanzi
niche_feature: Tented-cottage safari camp (two king doubles, four twins, plus two tented suites) on Maasai-owned land in the Chyulu Hills, with walking safaris; owned by Maasai Wilderness Conservation Trust.
evidence_quote: Set on 400,000 acres of Maasai-owned land, Campi ya Kanzi offers walking safaris and wildlife experiences led by Maasai guides
reason: Camp inside a private Maasai wildlife conservation area with wildlife viewing and walking safaris as core activities.
page_issues: Land area: andBeyond says 283,000 acres, operator site says 400,000 acres
'Eight tented rooms' fits 6 cottages + 2 suites; 'Amboseli ecosystem' framing and 'dining tent' not confirmed
Camp's own domain campiyakanzi.com now only shows webcams; county and nearest town not stated by the cited source

name: Jao Camp
niche_feature: Seven units (five suites and two villas) on a private island in the Jao Reserve, Okavango Delta; mokoro, boat and game-drive safaris. Described as architectural, not as treehouses.
evidence_quote: Jao comprises five en-suite suites and two exclusive villas, each with its own private plunge pool, lounge and dining areas
reason: Camp in a private Okavango Delta concession; wildlife viewing core; all units are suites or villas.
page_issues: Operator is now the independent Jao Reserve / Jao Collection, not Wilderness Safaris
'Treehouse-style architecture' not supported: official says modern architectural camp (third party: raised walkways, canvas and thatch)
Concession size given as 60,000 acres; third-party sources say 60,000 hectares
Superlatives ('finest concession', 'most singular') unsupported

name: Londolozi Varty Camp
niche_feature: Varty Camp, 10 chalets with private plunge pools on raised timber decks under riverine forest, within Londolozi Private Game Reserve in the Sabi Sand Game Reserve (Greater Kruger).
evidence_quote: Londolozi is situated on the banks of the Sand River, in the heart of the Sabi Sand Game Reserve within the Greater Kruger National Park.
reason: Camp in a private game reserve in the Greater Kruger with wildlife viewing as the core activity.
page_issues: Page says Varty Camp established in the 1970s; official site says Londolozi began in 1926 and Varty Camp is nearly 100 years old
'Birthplace of the modern luxury safari', 'most reliable leopard sightings in Africa', 'World's Best Leopard Sightings' are unsupported superlatives
Official site says Sabi Sand lies within the Greater Kruger; 'unfenced border with Kruger' not confirmed on cited pages

name: Okonjima Bush Camp
niche_feature: Luxury Bush Camp: eight thatched chalets and a Junior Suite (plus three guide/pilot tents) inside the Okonjima Nature Reserve, home to AfriCat; leopard and pangolin tracking.
evidence_quote: It comprises eight thatched, African-style chalets, a Junior Suite, and three en-suite, safari tents for your private guide or pilot.
reason: Camp inside a private nature reserve with wildlife tracking and game drives as core activities.
page_issues: Official name is 'Luxury Bush Camp' (one of five accommodation options); page calls it 'traditional safari camp'
Bush camp page itself says '2,000ha' reserve while the main site says 22,000 hectares (source inconsistency)

name: Rekero Camp
niche_feature: Nine safari tents (two family suites) on the Talek River in the Masai Mara National Reserve; open June to March, closed April and May.
evidence_quote: Nestled among the trees and overlooking the Talek River, nine classic and spacious safari tents await you.
reason: Tented camp inside Masai Mara National Reserve with wildlife viewing as the core activity.
page_issues: Operator is Asilia Africa, not Governors' Camp group
Page says ten tents; official says nine (including 2 family suites)
'Grove of fig trees' not confirmed; official says nestled among the trees
Camp is closed April to May; page implies year-round

name: Severin Safari Camp
niche_feature: Open, unfenced tented camp in Tsavo West National Park: luxury tents, junior and executive suites (tent canvas) and self-catering Kitani bandas 1.5 km away.
evidence_quote: Amidst Tsavo West National Park we have created a place that reflects the deep bond with the country like nothing else.
reason: Unfenced tented camp inside Tsavo West National Park with game drives as the main activity.
page_issues: Nearest-town transfer (Mtito Andei, Madaraka Express) not confirmed on the pages read
Official rooms also include self-catering bandas about 1.5 km from the main camp

name: Singita Grumeti
niche_feature: Singita's lodges and camps on the 350,000-acre Grumeti Reserve beside Serengeti National Park, managed with the Grumeti Fund; wildlife viewing is the core activity.
evidence_quote: Singita Grumeti, situated adjacent to the Serengeti National Park in Tanzania, is an integral part of the Serengeti-Mara ecosystem
reason: Lodges inside a private reserve adjoining Serengeti National Park, wildlife viewing core; all units are safari lodging.
page_issues: Page says only Sabora, Sasakwa and Faru Faru operate there; official lists seven (also Milele, Serengeti House, Explore, Kilima)
Page treats the whole reserve as one hotel; it is a collection of separate lodges
'Africa's finest safari service' and 'only vehicle present' are unsupported superlatives

name: Singita Lebombo Lodge
niche_feature: 13 glass-walled suites on a cliffside above the N'wanetsi River in a Singita concession in Kruger National Park; also an exclusive-use villa.
evidence_quote: Glass-walled and light-filled, the 13 contemporary suites ensure deeply moving connections with nature
reason: Lodge in a private concession inside Kruger National Park; wildlife viewing core.
page_issues: Page says fifteen suites; official says 13 suites (plus a separate villa)
15,000-hectare concession figure not confirmed (other sources: about 13,500 ha)
Province given as Limpopo; not confirmed from a source
'The finest address in South African safari' is an unsupported superlative

name: Wilderness Davison's Camp
niche_feature: Nine en-suite tents (including one family unit) in Hwange National Park overlooking a waterhole, in the Linkwasha-Makalolo Private Wilderness Area; classic game-viewing camp.
evidence_quote: Nestled in a grove of false mopane trees, nine, airy en-suite tents, including a family unit, make up the accommodation at Davison’s.
reason: Tented camp inside Hwange National Park with wildlife viewing as the core activity.
page_issues: 'Ngweshla Pan' name not found on the official page (waterhole only mentioned)
Page cites a 'Linkwasha Concession'; official calls it the Linkwasha-Makalolo Private Wilderness Area
Big Five and wild-dog claims not confirmed on the official page

name: Belmond Royal Scotsman
niche_feature: Luxury sleeper train with 18 sleeper cabins, two dining cars and an observation car; 2 to 7 night round trips from Edinburgh through the Scottish Highlands.
evidence_quote: Welcome aboard the Royal Scotsman, a unique luxury sleeper train exploring the Scottish Highlands.
reason: Guests sleep in private cabins aboard a luxury sleeper train.
page_issues: 'Britain's only luxury sleeper train' contradicted: Belmond also runs the Britannic Explorer sleeper train (England and Wales)
Cabin types outdated: official lists Grand Suites, Suites, Double and Twin Cabins (18 cabins), not single 'State Cabins'
Brand is now 'Royal Scotsman, A Belmond Train'; journey lengths are 2 to 7 nights, 'four-night Grand Tour' is stale (Grand Tour is 7 nights)

name: Ferienwaggons Zittauer Schmalspurbahn
niche_feature: Two passenger carriages converted into holiday apartments for two (kitchen, shower, bedroom, terrace) at Jonsdorf station (Easter to July) and Oybin station (August to October) on the narrow-gauge steam railway.
evidence_quote: Die in Ferienwohnungen umgebauten Personenwagen besitzen Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten für 2 Personen mit Küche, Duschbad, separiertem Schlafraum und Terrasse
reason: Guests sleep in stationary converted railway carriages; the railway's pension and apartment are separate offers.
page_issues: Official page lists carriages at Jonsdorf (bookable Easter to July) and Oybin (August to October); availability is seasonal per station
Railway also lets a pension and an apartment in station buildings (not carriages)
